case.pattern_description: This undocumented pattern involves a single device profile using an anonymous proxy to make online purchases across multiple unrelated cardholders within a short period. It was identified by tracing the device profile from transaction 3478561 to 24 other cards, including C02910-K1 and C02975-K1. This coordinated activity suggests a common actor targeting various accounts rather than a single compromised customer.

case.summary: Case HHG-014 was opened on 2016-11-22 following an analyst request to investigate card C13487-K1 for activity related to an unusual device profile. Two online transactions totaling $187.33 were identified as fraudulent after customer C13487 denied making the purchases. Evidence shows the device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M was used behind an anonymous proxy across 24 other cards, matching a known but undocumented pattern of coordinated abuse seen in cases CC-5122 and CC-3035. I recommend blocking the card and monitoring connected cards such as C01289-K1 and C01996-K2 due to this multi-cardholder compromise.

sar.narrative: Between 2016-11-15 and 2016-11-22, card C13487-K1 was used for two unauthorized online transactions totaling $187.33. The transactions, 3460634 and 3478561, were conducted using a Samsung SM-G935F device profile behind an anonymous proxy. Customer C13487 confirmed they did not authorize these charges and still possesses the physical card. Investigation revealed this specific device profile was used on 24 other cards within a 30 day window, including cards C03676-K2 and C04108-K2. This activity matches the coordinated abuse pattern documented in closed cases CC-2985 and CC-2971. The use of a hidden proxy and the high volume of unrelated cards linked to a single device profile indicate a sophisticated fraud operation. Consequently, the card has been blocked and a report is being filed per policy R9 for undocumented coordinated patterns.
